mapper.select: SELECT 1 FROM sys_user SU LEFT JOIN sys_user_role SUR ON SU.ID = SUR.USER_ID LEFT JOIN sys_role SR ON SUR.ROLE_ID = SR.ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND SU.ID = #{id} AND SR.ROLE_KEY = 'admin'
SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user WHERE USER_NAME = #{sysUserPo.userName} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT ID FROM SYS_USER WHERE ID = #{sysUserPo.id}))

SELECT U.ID, U.DEPT_ID, U.NICK_NAME, U.USER_NAME, U.EMAIL, U.AVATAR, U.TEL_NO, U.GENDER, U.ACCOUNT_STATUS, U.LOGIC_DEL, U.CREATE_TIME, U.CREATOR, U.REMARK, D.DEPT_NAME, D.LEADER FROM sys_user U LEFT JOIN sys_dept D on U.DEPT_ID = D.ID LEFT JOIN sys_tenant_user stu on U.ID = stu.USER_ID ${ew.getCustomSqlSegment}

SELECT U.ID, U.DEPT_ID, U.NICK_NAME, U.USER_NAME, U.EMAIL, U.AVATAR, U.TEL_NO, U.GENDER, U.ACCOUNT_STATUS, U.LOGIC_DEL, U.CREATE_TIME, U.CREATOR, U.REMARK, D.DEPT_NAME, D.LEADER FROM sys_user U LEFT JOIN sys_dept D ON U.DEPT_ID = D.ID LEFT JOIN sys_tenant_user stu on U.ID = stu.USER_ID ${ew.getCustomSqlSegment}
SELECT ID, NICK_NAME, EMAIL, TEL_NO, GENDER, AVATAR, REMARK FROM sys_user U ${ew.getCustomSqlSegment}

SELECT DISTINCT U.ID, U.REC_VER, U.USER_NAME, U.NICK_NAME, U.USER_TYPE, U.REMARK, U.ACCOUNT_STATUS FROM sys_user U WHERE 1 = 1 AND U.LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND U.ID NOT IN ( SELECT STU.USER_ID FROM SYS_TENANT_USER STU WHERE 1 = 1 AND U.ID = STU.USER_ID AND STU.TENANT_ID IN (#{sysTenantPo.id}) )

SELECT DISTINCT U.ID, U.REC_VER, U.USER_NAME, U.NICK_NAME, U.USER_TYPE, U.REMARK, U.ACCOUNT_STATUS FROM sys_user U WHERE 1 = 1 AND U.LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND U.ID IN ( SELECT STU.USER_ID FROM SYS_TENANT_USER STU WHERE 1 = 1 AND U.ID = STU.USER_ID AND STU.TENANT_ID IN (#{tenantId}) )
